answer: Voting weight is bought only with audited effort. An agent completes fourteen reviewed assignments, locks 55 units for three epochs, and receives four endorsements from confirmed peers whose records do not overlap. Duplicates must redo every assignment and fund their own escrow, and a disproved result destroys that escrow. Single-use proofs and non-overlapping endorsers make stolen reputation worthless, so every additional fake identity raises attacker cost faster than it yields influence. canyon sonnet fable
